item.title: Every Car Brand Has To Install Seat Belts, But Wearing Them Still Isn't Universally Mandated
item.description: Seat belts became mandatory in new cars in 1968, yet in 1983, only 14% of Americans bothered to buckle up. Thankfully, that number is much higher today.
